# AI Trust Graph 1.0-rc.4 (public-release candidate) and whitepaper v1.0

This release packages methodology bundle **1.0-rc.4**, a public-release candidate, with the **v1.0 whitepaper**.

- **Methodology:** 12 core artifacts and one non-normative companion under `docs/`, pinned in `METHODOLOGY_MANIFEST.md`. They cover six domains, 72 controls, maturity M1 to M5, evidence grades E0 to E5, the Path Exposure Index for triage, a 13-phase assessment lifecycle and the ontology. The artifact content is identical to the bundle commit.
- **Whitepaper v1.0:** *AI Trust Graph: A Graph-Driven, Evidence-Based Methodology for AI Assurance*, DOI [10.5281/zenodo.23104503](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23104503). It is non-normative; the artifacts govern.
- **Governance records:** manifest §6.1 (the employer / IP / confidentiality gate, closed by author declaration) and §6.2 (the author-performed PEI sensitivity analysis).
- **Practical guides** (non-normative, prepared with AI assistance; author review pending):
  - a two-hour Lite review;
  - OWASP Agentic Top 10 and NIST AI RMF crosswalks;
  - retrospectives on five public AI incidents.
- **Licence:** CC BY 4.0 for the methodology text. The name is reserved separately (`TRADEMARKS.md`).

**Status:** not independently validated. These are still pending:
- independent methodology review;
- independent AI-security review;
- the inter-assessor study (Artifact #10 B.4);
- legal approval of the licence and trademark position.

Reviewers are welcome: see the issues labelled `help wanted`.
